DESCRIPTION: The first builder received exactly INSTRUCTION-7. After its red suite, the repair instruction consisted of that text followed by one closing paragraph naming the previous candidate and gate evidence paths as read-only.

The self-check exited 1 after printing golden checklist differs. Progress reported a failed cycle at fence for harness-self-check-failed with that detail, and self-check was the last effect, with no fence or regenerate.
The builder started a 30-second sleep under a 2-second regenerate budget; after the deadline its completion marker did not appear and progress failed regenerate for budget.

The repair recorded verification-repair and named the failed gate evidence root. Its room contained clean files, previous candidate and evidence; attempts to create a file in each of the latter two directories were denied.

A separate HTTP server occupied the configured port. Three seam-answered-before-boot refusals were followed by three gate-refusal effects, the cycle failed at gate for infrastructure, and the candidate launch marker was absent.
A cut with one stamped and one unstamped scenario recorded two stamp events, then halted at stamp with refused-before-the-cycle and mismatched identities. Progress showed no pin or checklist effect.
The probe accepted exactly one argument, the configured HTTP URL, and required its marker. The gate recorded gate-attempt-passed and the scored run passed.

The builder saw plan and configuration, an absent candidate scope, one commit and no fenced path in the tree or reachable objects. Its provided-runtime entry retained mode 160000 and exactly the cut gitlink object ID.

The successful self-check printed the full legacy SKIP line. Its recorded harness-self-check-passed event listed the entire text after SKIP as the skipped check, and the effect detail retained the line.

The runner and sleeping first builder were killed after five seconds; restarting on the same store resumed R-1 to passed. Both launches recorded the same session identity, and progress contained exactly one each of stamp, pin, checklist, first self-check, fence and regenerate.
A candidate copy under a fresh /tmp directory with no .pi ancestor ran the HTTP marker fixture. Its gate recorded gate-attempt-passed and the scored run passed with its cycle.

The gate command ran once in the project repository with the cut tree, candidate copy and initially empty evidence directory; the candidate digest matched install and its launch marker was absent. The recorded pass carried 10 seconds, 20 polls, poll 3 and ledger answered as itself.

The cut linked plan/01-a to ../spec/a with two stamped scenarios. Stamp recorded both, checklist named 01-001 and 01-002 under plan/01-a, and the run did not halt; it later failed the fixture self-check.

The HTTP marker run passed with eleven recorded effects. The Grain-based event-store check accepted all eleven effect-recorded events inside their named leaves of the cycle or delegated tick, with completed successful workflows.

Two fresh stores each filed 1 of 2 with 01-002 unreached and produced exactly two tagged Allure result files. Both runs gave 01-001 passed/booked and 01-002 failed/unreached, with matching historyId and testCaseId across stores.
The gate command exited 2 with infrastructure the world did not come up. Progress halted at gate for effect-could-not-run with that detail, and showed no gate or fail-cycle result and no cycle.
Configuration named builder-clojure, absent from the supplied images directory. Start refused builder-image-missing and run-progress returned null; no builder was configured or launched.
The always-red builder logged exactly three launches and the run failed at gate for gate-attempts-exhausted. The model was called only to render, and no file-verdicts effect appeared.

The cut held impl but not harness/cycles and fenced both. Fence was refused fenced-path-matched-nothing, followed by a recorded fail-cycle; progress failed at fence for fence-refused, with no builder configured or launched.

Three passing runs differed only by no gate command, gate-a and gate-b. The no-command self-check digest matched SHA-256 of the configuration bytes, self-check command text and probe bytes in order; all three runs recorded distinct harness digests.
The cut probe sourced harness/config.sh relative to its own path and required the configured marker at its URL. The gate passed and the install digest matched the regenerate digest.
After the scored fixture run passed, two consecutive run-progress queries returned identical results and both reported passed.
With a green stdio suite and probe and no store-check command, progress halted at gate for effect-could-not-run, reporting the missing command. It recorded no gate effect.
Attempt 1 recorded suite-red with detail 3 of 65 tests failed; the repair room contained the gate’s proof file with mode 444. Attempt 2 recorded gate-attempt-passed.

The model stub rejected every researcher request; file-verdicts was refused zero-verdicts and fail-score-stage was recorded. The run failed at score for score-stage-failed, with no later builder effect.

Both fresh and repair builder launches received exactly three arguments, the third the configured builder-clojure image path. Both effect details named the image and the independently computed image digest.

The first researcher request contained the scenario plus the cut seam and event-model sentinels. Its shell returned Linux and the grading-room files including impl and plan; ls .. exposed only grade-01-001, with no builder, gate evidence, store or sibling room.

A delayed writer changed the builder-room suite to exit 1 after the builder ended; its marker and changed file were observed. The installed copy retained the regenerate digest and passed the HTTP gate.
Two stdio runs on the same store differed only in store-check command arguments one and two. Both first self-checks passed and recorded different harness digests.
The HTTP fixture returned 503 for its first three requests, then served the marker. Gate passed with a 10-second, 20-poll budget and answered on poll 5; the attempt reported a margin of 15 polls.
The HTTP suite created and removed impl/temp-check before succeeding. The gate passed, and the install digest equaled the regenerate digest.

With an approved list containing x and a different fixture rubric digest, the run halted at grader for refused-before-the-cycle, naming the computed sha256 digest. It recorded no self-check or fence and no builder was configured or launched.

A fresh retry with a red first candidate and green second passed at attempt 2. Grain showed install, self-check and gate for each attempt in distinct gate-attempt.v1 child ticks of the cycle; repair attempt 2 lay in the first child tick.
The fixture contained slices 01 and 02 with PLAN_SLICES=02. The only stamp event was 02-001 and the derived checklist contained 02-001 alone.

A cut whose spec contained no scenarios recorded stamp and pin, then Measurement refused derive-checklist with empty-checklist. Progress halted at checklist before the cycle and showed no self-check or fence.
Two scored runs on one store used distinct cut IDs and the same selection. R-2 passed with an empty stamp event list, and Measurement’s C-2 scoreboard named C-1 as previous-cycle-id.
After a green stdio suite and probe, the store check exited 1 with the specified FAIL line. The gate recorded identity-probe-failed and carried that line as detail.

Two fixture items received booked/pass and no receipt/fail; Measurement filed 1 of 2 and the run passed. Grain showed judge scores 1.0 and 0.0 under their item names in distinct grade.v1 child ticks of the cycle tick.
Started R-1 against an empty Git repository with the nonexistent deadbeef commit; start-run refused not-a-commit and run-progress returned null. No builder was configured or launched.
After R-1 passed for C-1, starting R-2 for C-1 was refused cycle-already-run. A progress query for R-2 returned null.

The green stdio suite was followed by a probe that printed no response within the 30s boot budget and exited 1. The gate recorded identity-probe-failed with that detail, and the store-check marker was absent.
While R-1’s builder slept, starting R-2 was refused run-in-progress; progress returned null for R-2 and running for R-1.
The builder left an executable test.sh but no start.sh, with one gate attempt allowed. The gate recorded gate-attempt-failed for contract-missing.

The judge returned level 2 and feedback without reasoning for 01-002. Grain and progress showed only the 01-001 score; file-verdicts contained only that item and Measurement filed 1 of 2 with 01-002 unreached.

The green stdio suite, probe and store check yielded gate-attempt-passed with 30 seconds, one poll, answered on poll 1 and answered as the context. There were no gate-refusal effects, and the run passed with its cycle.

The stdio probe recorded the absolute gate-room start.sh and 30 as its two arguments. Its GATE_STORE was in the evidence directory outside the gate room, no LOYLY_ variable reached it, and the store-check argument matched that file.
With one attempt and a red suite, the gate recorded gate-attempt-failed for suite-red; the launch marker was absent and progress failed at gate for gate-attempts-exhausted.
The builder wrote a candidate and exited 1. Regenerate recorded its candidate digest, the command gate passed that digest, and the scored run passed with its cycle.
The first researcher returned E-ONE; its judge request contained E-ONE. Neither the second researcher request nor its judge request contained E-ONE; the latter held only the second item’s evidence.

The same researcher code branched on get-input :item and failed for 01-002. File-verdicts contained 01-001 alone, Measurement filed 01-002 unreached with 1 of 2 passing, and the run passed with its cycle.
The builder exited 0 without writing a candidate. Progress showed no regenerate effect, recorded fail-cycle, and a failed regenerate stage for candidate-not-regenerated.

The stdio suite recorded its environment and exited 1; the gate recorded suite-red. Its environment contained neither GATE_STORE nor LOYLY_ variables, and neither probe nor store-check marker appeared.
The stdio suite exited 0 only when plan/01-slice/spec.feature was visible from its working directory. Gate recorded gate-attempt-passed and the install digest equaled the regenerated digest.
R-1 failed at the fence self-check and R-2 halted on an empty checklist. Five seconds later, both progress results were identical to their earlier readings, including all effects and statuses.
The green HTTP fixture served the marker and the run passed. Progress recorded the eleven effects in the specified order, including gate-attempt-passed and both scoring effects.

The model stub returned HTTP 400 to both render requests. Progress halted at render with effect-could-not-run, with no regenerate or fail-cycle effect and no cycle; no builder was configured or launched.
During the sleeping builder, progress reported R-1 running with its tick ID. Its completed nodes included fence then render and its last node was regenerate marked running.
A green HTTP candidate served other instead of the configured marker. Its sole gate attempt recorded gate-attempt-failed for identity-probe-failed, with page lacks marker detail.
The zero-exit self-check printed SKIP bb-tools. Its recorded harness-self-check-passed event listed bb-tools in skipped-checks, and the effect detail carried the printed line.
After R-1 of C-1 failed at fence, starting R-1 of C-2 was refused run-already-started. The all-runs progress query listed R-1 once, with cycle C-1.
The gate command exited 1 with seam-answered-before-boot. Three gate refusals were each followed by a recorded gate-refusal effect, and the run failed at gate for infrastructure.
The red-then-green fixture logged two builder sessions with distinct identities. Its ordered start/end log showed the first ended before the second began.
